mapper.sql: SELECT t.payslip_id, t.year_month, t.employee_id, t.employee_name, t.employee_no, t.org_id, t.basic_salary, t.position_salary, t.skill_allowance, t.seniority_pay, t.night_allowance, t.high_temp_allowance, t.hazard_allowance, t.meal_allowance, t.transport_allowance, t.full_attendance_bonus, t.piecework_pay, t.overtime_pay, t.performance_bonus, t.absence_deduction, t.other_add, t.other_deduct, t.gross_salary, t.social_insurance, t.house_fund, t.income_tax, t.other_deduction, t.net_salary, t.calc_status, t.sealed_by, t.sealed_time, t.pay_date, t.bank_receipt_no, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, d.dept_name AS org_name FROM biz_hr_payslip t LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON t.org_id = d.dept_id
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_hr_payslip SET del_flag = '2' WHERE payslip_id = #{payslipId}
UPDATE biz_hr_payslip SET del_flag = '2' WHERE payslip_id IN #{payslipId}
